verdicts.reason: A is the original pasted unchanged into the middle of a wider canvas: the blue header band stops short of both edges, leaving odd white strips, and the content has not been rearranged for the new shape. Even so, every element is intact, readable and in order. B is broken: the blue header covers the Vienna row, so the city name and the $109 price are cut off, the destination list has been reshuffled, the legal line now sits above the CTA, and the centred logo does not line up with the left-aligned headline.
